symbols.name: _WINDOW
symbols.signature: _WINDOW = 8  # lines a quote may span (joined imports, multi-line signatures); longer quotes get their own length

symbols.name: _MIN_TOKEN_QUOTE
symbols.signature: _MIN_TOKEN_QUOTE = 3  # identifier tokens needed before the in-order token fallback is trusted

symbols.name: _EXCERPT
symbols.signature: _EXCERPT = 300  # longest source text stored per fact (a minified one-line file would repeat itself per fact)

symbols.name: _LINE_BREAK_RE
symbols.signature: _LINE_BREAK_RE = re.compile(r"\r\n|\r|\n")  # what editors, GitHub and models count; str.splitlines also splits at \f, \x85, U+2028

symbols.name: _OWNER_EXCLUDED_KINDS
symbols.signature: _OWNER_EXCLUDED_KINDS = {"method"}  # called on objects of any type: proves nothing about which file a line uses

symbols.name: _INDEX_STEMS
symbols.signature: _INDEX_STEMS = ("mod", "index", "__init__", "init", "main", "lib")  # the file a directory import means, in this preference

symbols.name: _BARE_NAME_RE
symbols.signature: _BARE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w-]+$")  # a package name without any path part

symbols.name: _SEGMENT_RE
symbols.signature: _SEGMENT_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w$@~-]+$")  # path segments; drops grouped-import lists such as {Repo, StoreError}

symbols.name: _GO_BLOCK_LINE_RE
symbols.signature: _GO_BLOCK_LINE_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:[\w.]+\s+)?"[^"]+"\s*$')  # a bare quoted path, e.g. inside import ( ... )

symbols.name: _OWNER_EXCLUDED_KINDS

symbols.name: _INDEX_STEMS

symbols.name: _BARE_NAME_RE

symbols.name: _SEGMENT_RE

symbols.name: _GO_BLOCK_LINE_RE
